contracts.packingFrames: Only source-enabled expanding box/rectpacking parent permits nonshrinking engine node dimension change. Layered fixed dimensions remain exact. PlacedNode.box is physical engine frame. Ordinary measured outline/label retain original dimensions, centered in physical box, matching cached nodeElems position-only paint. Intersections use that actual ink box and pure measured outline. Diagram title union uses these centered ink boxes without mutating returned physical geometry. Optional paint_box also records source small-side alignment; use paint_box or box before centering cached ink. Raw engine frame never changes.
contracts.straightening: Both terminal fronts: max port run30, jog in[.01,16], unchanged ports, same onward direction and full channel move; no move if far terminal dragged. Reject candidate increasing strict crossings or label-over-edge pairs. Only moved original run determines main-label projection.
contracts.hops: Default on, false off, gap or arc. Source orientation: horizontal edge gives way, otherwise later index. Endpoint epsilon1e-6; skip rounded-corner crossings; radius6, clearance2, useful floor .6, neighboring hops shrink and recheck. contracts.markers: none/point/circle/cross, both ends. s4CylinderCapRegression.derivation: Source inner arc is appended on right x=width, or x=width/2 before only outer translation in handDrawn. With bbox normalization outerW=bodyWidth+2rx, inner arc spans [bodyWidth,bodyWidth+rx]=[outerW-2rx,outerW-rx]. Left body has no mirrored inner arc. h=labelHeight+(neo12 ornodePadding/2), rx=(h/2)/(2.5+h/50).
s4CylinderCapRegression.positiveGeometry: Classic,neo,handDrawn source factory dimensions and right-component bounds compared with independent public native Path2D bounds; all inner components must lie on right half.
s4CylinderCapRegression.positivePNG: Real render API + real ELK + native Canvas. Source analytic inner tangent outerW-2rx must contain dark PNG pixels, counterfactual2rx on left must stay white. minNodeWidth160 with shortCap text isolates probes from glyphs.
s4CylinderCapRegression.negativeControl: Only in-memory session measurement shape factory patched to return deliberate left inner arc. Actual public API still layouts/renders it; same pixel probe must see erroneous left ink and no right inner ink. This catches the original fault instead of trusting trace/path declarations. No production file changed.
